why: enumerates the groups a node owns. A node owns none here. RFC-0047: a callback group here is a NAME, not an object the executor holds. The group structure is declared in code (`Node::create_callback_group("ctrl")`) and the group -> tier POLICY is declared in the workspace `system.toml`; the executor carries a config-seeded `group -> sched_context` table and binds each callback to its group's context at REGISTRATION, once, into a fixed arena. There is no group object to add to or remove from an executor, and no membership that can change after registration.
